It's getting close to the next PCGG so if you're in driving, flying, walking, bounding, slithering, crawling, capering or gamboling distance of Bonaire GA in May please plan to attend. There's no charge except that you need to have a desire to talk holography most of the weekend.

We need people to give talks, chair roundtables, generally spark discussions ask questions or just show off their work.

[http://www.holographyforum.org/phpBB2/v ... 5088#35088](http://www.holographyforum.org/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?p=35088#35088)
